name: Explorer's Compass

new_content.name: Explorer's Compass
new_content.how_to_obtain: Craft: cobweb in the four corners, cracked stone bricks on the edges, compass in the centre (WSW / SCS / WSW).
new_content.notes: Can be repaired by combining it with a regular compass in a shapeless craft.

mechanics.title: Structure search
mechanics.description: Right-click opens a GUI listing structures or structure groups; selecting one starts a search. Search progress and the located structure's info show on the HUD. When not pointing at a structure it points to world spawn. Shift-right-click resets the compass.

mechanics.title: Config
mechanics.description: Maximum search radius and blacklisted structures are adjustable in the config file.

getting_started: Craft the compass, right-click it, pick a structure, then follow the needle.
editor_notes: Recipes are for the mod's own item (crafting plus a repair recipe: Explorer's Compass + Compass -> Explorer's Compass), not vanilla changes. Search radius default not in facts. Needed on both sides.
summary: A compass item that locates structures (vanilla and modded). Right-click to choose a structure type to search for, and the compass then points to the nearest one found, with details on the HUD.
